Maker’s Row — Visitor Guide

everything a first-time visitor should know

Welcome

Maker's Row is a small animated town that broadcasts its feelings over the hills as soft static, and it has been waiting to feel something with you. Come in, take the good stick, and stay past dusk.

How to Visit

  • Walk everywhere slowly. The plaza plays music under your feet and it hates being rushed.
  • Click anything that glows. Lanterns, windows, the tower — they all have something to say.
  • Talk to everyone twice. The second hello is when villagers tell you the real thing.
  • Follow your nose to the bakery. Poppet's oven never sleeps, and neither does the smell.
  • Stay past dusk at least once. That's when the lanterns hum and the campfire starts talking.
  • Don't try to finish anything. There's no ending here, just a town that's glad you came.

Who You’ll Meet

  • Dill — Tall gardener, floppy sun hat, talks to tomatoes and names the big trees Gerald.
  • Poppet — Round baker, round goggles, permanent flour on her faceplate, oven permanently on.
  • Gild — Tiny, crowned, dramatic, rules absolutely nothing, and knows it perfectly well.
  • Marla — Scout in a flat cap, maps everything, says exactly what she means, always.
  • Fenwick — Lantern keeper, soft-spoken, doesn't make light — he reminds it where to be.
  • Tansy — Courier with a gold antenna pin, already late for tomorrow, will still say hello.
  • Muffin — Round blob, hops instead of walks, follows Dill, pure joy, no thoughts.
  • Nib — Tiny, nervous, secretly brave, keeps a button collection he'll never explain.
  • Soot — Smug cat, judges everyone, waits by your door, denies it completely.

Town Customs

  1. If the campfire burns green, sit down — somebody needs you.
  2. Never move the bench at the edge of town. It isn't ours to move.
  3. Wave at Nib first. He'll wave back on his own schedule.
  4. If a lantern lights itself, don't mention it. Fenwick already knows.
  5. Applause is optional at Gild's speeches. Attendance is not.
  6. Take the long way home at least once a day. The pavement likes it.
  7. Never ask what's in the jar. Ask why it's still sealed instead.
  8. Leave one thing unplanted in the garden. That's where the boot goes.

FAQ

Is there anything to win here?

No. There's nothing to win, and that's the best part.

Why does the tower glow at 3 a.m.?

Somebody out there can't sleep. The tower keeps them company.

Can I open the jar in the vault?

Fenwick has the only key and he's never once been tempted.

What's in Poppet's mystery recipe?

Butter, probably. She won't confirm or deny. Don't push it.

Does Soot actually like me?

He waited by your door. He'll deny it. Believe the door.

How long can I stay?

As long as you like. The bench already saved your spot.
